abilities.name: Master of the Cold Dark
abilities.description: Quest Gain 1 Blight every time a Hero is Rooted by Frost Nova or hit by Chains of Kel'Thuzad. After gaining 15 Blight, gain the Glacial Spike Ability. Reward After gaining 30 Blight, gain 75% Spell Power.

fields.notes: Unstoppable enemy Heroes cannot be Rooted and thus do not grant stacks from being hit by Frost Nova. Chains of Kel'Thuzad, however, still does as it only requires hitting enemy Heroes. Spell Power from Master of the Cold Dark stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power as well as other offensive damage and healing dealt modifiers affecting Kel'Thuzad's Spell Damage or healing output.

abilities.name: Death and Decay
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, launch an orb that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 150 damage to enemies in the area. The explosion leaves behind a pool of decay that lasts 2 seconds, dealing 82 damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Skillshot, Splash
fields.notes: Units that are immune to skillshots cannot be hit by the initial projectile, but can still be damaged by the splash and AoE damage. Casting Death and Decay sets Kel'Thuzad's Basic Attack cooldown to 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Create a nova that explodes after 1 second, dealing 180 damage to enemies inside and Slowing them by 35% for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the center are Rooted for 1 second.

fields.notes: Enemies hit by the center are both Rooted and Slowed. Casting Frost Nova sets Kel'Thuzad's Basic Attack cooldown to 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Chains of Kel'Thuzad
abilities.description: Launch a chain, dealing 97 damage to the first enemy Hero hit. For 3 seconds after hitting an enemy, Chains can be reactivated to launch to an additional enemy, pulling both enemies together and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Chain is launched from primary target toward target point on reactivation. If one target is Unstoppable, the other is pulled all the way to them. Casting Chains of Kel'Thuzad sets Kel'Thuzad's Basic Attack cooldown to 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Blast
abilities.description: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115 damage to its target and 275 damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Frost Blast missile can only be disjointed if the target dies, is removed from the plane (certain Stasis effects) or instantly teleports farther than 30 units from its previous location. When disjointed, the missile explodes upon reaching the target's location before the event. Otherwise, the missile will keep redirecting to the target unit. Frost Blast always explodes, applying its area effects upon reaching the end location, regardless of being able to hit its original target. Primary target does not take area damage. Casting Frost Blast sets Kel'Thuzad's Basic Attack cooldown to 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Shadow Fissure
abilities.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320 damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Casting Shadow Fissure sets Kel'Thuzad's Basic Attack cooldown to 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Glacial Spike
abilities.description: Activate to create a spike that detonates after 4 seconds, dealing 70 damage to nearby enemies. The spike can be affected by Chains of Kel'Thuzad. Yellowtext Quest requirements must be completed before activating.

fields.notes: The spike has collision.

talents.name: The Plaguelands
talents.description: Increase Death and Decay's duration by 1 second. After gaining 30 Blight, increase the radius of Death and Decay's pool by 30%.

fields.notes: Does not affect the initial splash radius.

_raw_fields: Increase Death and Decay's duration by 1 second. After gaining 30 Blight, increase the radius of Death and Decay's pool by 30%.

talents.name: Blighted Frost
talents.description: Frost Nova deals 75% more damage to enemies in the center. After gaining 30 Blight, increase Frost Nova's Root duration by 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Frost Nova 's damage.

_raw_fields: Frost Nova deals 75% more damage to enemies in the center. After gaining 30 Blight, increase Frost Nova's Root duration by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Barbed Chains
talents.description: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad's damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier / Offensive damage modifier
fields.notes: Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers.

_raw_fields: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad's damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Strip Shields
talents.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad grants Kel'Thuzad a permanent 128 Shield, stacking up to 2 times. Additionally, Chains of Kel'Thuzad deals up to 270 bonus damage to Shields.

fields.notes: Damage is dealt to Shields only, cannot overflow to the target unit.

_raw_fields: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad grants Kel'Thuzad a permanent 128 Shield, stacking up to 2 times. Additionally, Chains of Kel'Thuzad deals up to 270 bonus damage to Shields.

talents.name: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
talents.description: Quest Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery. Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again. Passive Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

fields.notes: All stacks are consumed and passive effect is lost when the Ability is activated.

_raw_fields: Quest Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery. Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again. Passive Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

talents.name: Armor of the Archlich
talents.description: Cooldown 25 Active Activate to gain 50 Physical Armor for 4 seconds. Upon activation, nearby enemies take 45 damage and are Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Defensive damage modifier
fields.props: Area of Effect, Physical Armor, Slow

_raw_fields: Cooldown 25 Active Activate to gain 50 Physical Armor for 4 seconds. Upon activation, nearby enemies take 45 damage and are Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

talents.name: Accelerated Decay
talents.description: Each time a Hero is hit by Death and Decay's pool, they take 25% more periodic damage from Death and Decay for the next 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

fields.notes: Counter tracks each enemy Hero affected by Death and Decay separately. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers.

_raw_fields: Each time a Hero is hit by Death and Decay's pool, they take 25% more periodic damage from Death and Decay for the next 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

talents.name: Chilling Touch
talents.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80% additional damage, deals Spell Damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Chilling Touch 's damage.

_raw_fields: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80% additional damage, deals Spell Damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

talents.name: Ice Cold
talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of Glacial Spike by 10 seconds and increase its damage by 400%.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Glacial Spike 's damage.

_raw_fields: Reduce the cooldown of Glacial Spike by 10 seconds and increase its damage by 400%.

talents.description: Increase Frost Nova's Slow by 20%. Each time Kel'Thuzad damages enemies Slowed by Frost Nova, reduce the cooldown of Frost Nova by 0.75 seconds.

fields.notes: Cooldown reduction is triggered by every tick of damage dealt by Kel'Thuzad from both Basic Attacks and Abilities.

talents.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, targets are Slowed by 60% for 1 seconds.

fields.notes: The slow effect is not applied if the stun is cleansed.

talents.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces its cooldown by 5 seconds and refunds its Mana cost.
_raw_fields: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces its cooldown by 5 seconds and refunds its Mana cost.

talents.name: Arcane Echoes
talents.description: Whenver Kel'Thuzad hits an enemy Hero with Death and Decay's explosion, its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Whenver Kel'Thuzad hits an enemy Hero with Death and Decay's explosion, its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

talents.name: Hungering Cold
talents.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

fields.notes: Bonus damage is added to every tick of damage dealt by Kel'Thuzad from both Basic Attacks and Abilities.

_raw_fields: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55 damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

talents.name: Power of Icecrown
talents.description: Stunning, Rooting, or Slowing a Hero grants 6% Spell Power for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

fields.notes: Spell Power stacks additively with itself and offensive damage modifiers affecting Kel'Thuzad's Spell Damage output.

_raw_fields: Stunning, Rooting, or Slowing a Hero grants 6% Spell Power for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Deathchill
talents.description: When Frost Blast's Root expires, enemies are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Heroes killed while under the effects of Frost Blast instantly release another Frost Blast explosion.

fields.notes: The post-Root Slow from Deathchill also counts as being affected by Frost Blast, triggering the secondary explosion upon a Hero's death.

_raw_fields: When Frost Blast's Root expires, enemies are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Heroes killed while under the effects of Frost Blast instantly release another Frost Blast explosion.

talents.name: Might of the Scourge
talents.description: If a Hero is hit with Shadow Fissure, a second one is cast below them 1 second later. This second cast will not duplicate itself.

fields.notes: The secondary explosion has the same area and initial delay, which starts after the 1 second secondary cast delay, as the original, but it does not grant the cooldown reduction upon hitting an enemy Hero

talents.name: Shifting Malice
talents.description: Cooldown 240 Active Activate to dash forward, dealing 150 damage to enemies in the path. Takedowns reset the cooldown of Shifting Malice.

talents.name: The Damned Return
talents.description: Cooldown 15 Active Activate to create a Shade of Naxxramas that lasts 15 seconds and mimics Kel'Thuzad's casts of Death and Decay.

fields.notes: Shade is Invulnerable and Untargetable and has no collision. Shade's Death and Decay benefits from all talents affecting it.
